title: audio track model groundwork
description:
AUD-02/AUD-03 (Stage C): AudioStore persists the audio track
model into project.json's new "audio" section — the SIXTH
section alongside grades/sources/exports/luts/timeline, following
the TimelineStore store pattern (data/audio stays a new package;
the only touch outside it is the one additive ProjectJson hook).

- AudioStore.kt: render/parse the "audio" section (an object:
  version, links, clips), persist via ProjectJson.withSection so
  every save re-renders only its own section and preserves the
  other five raw. Atomic write: sibling .tmp + rename with the
  copy fallback. Version field in the section (v1); migration
  stance documented (the TimelineStore precedent): forward-
  tolerant parse, absent-field defaults, missing section loads
  the default empty project, corrupt section loads default
  without touching the raw file. Per-row tolerance: an unknown
  state string, a non-po
changed: feat: audio link state and clip model
